hebrewText: אֲפָפ֤וּ/נִי מַ֨יִם֙ עַד נֶ֔פֶשׁ תְּה֖וֹם יְסֹבְבֵ֑/נִי ס֖וּף חָב֥וּשׁ לְ/רֹאשִֽׁ/י

tokens.bdb: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
tokens.explanation: mayim — água, rio, mar (sempre plural em hebraico)

tokens.bdb: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
tokens.kjv: against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for(-asmuch as), (hither-) to, [phrase] how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, ([phrase] as) yet.

tokens.bdb: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
tokens.kjv: any, appetite, beast, body, breath, creature, [idiom] dead(-ly), desire, [idiom] (dis-) contented, [idiom] fish, ghost, [phrase] greedy, he, heart(-y), (hath, [idiom] jeopardy of) life ([idiom] in jeopardy), lust, man, me, mind, mortally, one, own, person, pleasure, (her-, him-, my-, thy-) self, them (your) -selves, [phrase] slay, soul, [phrase] tablet, they, thing, ([idiom] she) will, [idiom] would have it.
tokens.explanation: nefesh — alma, ser vivo, vida, pessoa, desejo interior

tokens.bdb: an abyss (as a surging mass of water), especially the deep (the main sea or the subterranean watersupply)
tokens.explanation: tehom — abismo, oceano primordial, profundezas das águas

tokens.bdb: to revolve, surround, or border; used in various applications, literally and figuratively
tokens.kjv: bring, cast, fetch, lead, make, walk, [idiom] whirl, [idiom] round about, be about on every side, apply, avoid, beset (about), besiege, bring again, carry (about), change, cause to come about, [idiom] circuit, (fetch a) compass (about, round), drive, environ, [idiom] on every side, beset (close, come, compass, go, stand) round about, inclose, remove, return, set, sit down, turn (self) (about, aside, away, back).

tokens.bdb: to wrap firmly (especially a turban, compress, or saddle); figuratively, to stop, to rule
tokens.kjv: bind (up), gird about, govern, healer, put, saddle, wrap about.

tokens.bdb: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
tokens.kjv: band, beginning, captain, chapiter, chief(-est place, man, things), company, end, [idiom] every (man), excellent, first, forefront, (be-)head, height, (on) high(-est part, (priest)), [idiom] lead, [idiom] poor, principal, ruler, sum, top.
